messages.subject: [R-sig-Fedora] Updating some rpm R packages
messages.body_plain:
I noticed that some of my R packages that have been repacked in fedora
are quite outdated, including:

 - R-curl
 - R-openssl
 - R-xml2

These packages will need to be updated to work with the latest
versions of libcurl, libxml2, libssl, because each of these upstream
libs has had breaking changes recently.

messages.subject: [R-sig-Fedora] Updating some rpm R packages
messages.body_plain:
Yeap, many packages are outdated because we lack hands, time for the hands
available, and the current guidelines do not scale very well. Also there
are other, better, solutions for getting binary packages, including yours,
and including my own Copr repo for Fedora, so I only update packages in the
official repos when I'm forced to (e.g. when they fail and block an R
update). Or if you poke me a bit.

Thanks for the heads-up. Updated now.

I?aki
